lines.en: Roaring as it strides forward
Opens its huge jaws, showing sharp teeth
Swings its massive tail

lines.zh: 步履沉重，每一步都震颤地面
lines.en: Walks with heavy steps, shaking the ground

lines.zh: 这片地界是我的，退出去。
lines.en: This territory is mine. Get out.
Locks eyes on its prey
Muscles bulge, ready to attack
Growls and moves forward
Grinds its teeth on the rocks
Heavy breathing echoes

lines.zh: 三趾踏过碎石，扬起尘土
lines.en: Three-toed feet crunch the gravel and raise dust.
Its tail swings out to keep balance.
It patrols back and forth along its border.
It lowers its body and slips past the brush.

lines.zh: 脚爪扣进泥土，稳步前行
lines.en: Claws dig into the dirt as it strides.
It sniffs along the edge of its territory.
Lazily basking in the sun
Staring at the horizon
Grooming its body
Resting on the grass
Looking up at the sky

lines.zh: 咀嚼着草食性恐龙的残骸
lines.en: Chewing on the remains of herbivores
Stretches and yawns
Enjoys the breeze
Closes its eyes, feeling the sun
Rolling in the soft grass
One bite from me can crush bone.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖懒懒地敲打地面
lines.en: Its tail tip taps lazily on the ground.
It opens its mouth to cool off, tongue quivering.

lines.zh: 它侧耳听着远处的动静
lines.en: It tilts its head toward a sound far off.
Staring at the player, ready to hunt

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，喉咙发出咕噜声
lines.en: Locking on to the player, throat rumbles
I've buried bones in this ground.
Growls, preparing to attack
Staring at the player, showing fangs

lines.zh: 喉咙咕噜着，发出警告声
lines.en: Throat rumbles, warning sound

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，露出满口牙。
lines.en: I lower my neck and bare a mouthful of teeth.
Growls, warning the player

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，露出凶狠的目光
lines.en: Staring at the player, with fierce eyes

lines.zh: 喉咙咕噜着，准备扑向玩家
lines.en: Throat rumbles, ready to pounce

lines.zh: 它眯起眼，估算你的体型
lines.en: It narrows its eyes, sizing up your build.
Its nostrils puff white breath toward you.

lines.zh: 它对你咧嘴，露出整排牙
lines.en: It grins at you, showing a full row of teeth.

lines.zh: 它的头微低，盯着你的手
lines.en: Its head dips, eyes fixed on your hands.
It sidesteps, keeping out of your line of sight.

lines.zh: 它把你看成闯进领地的
lines.en: It reads you as a trespasser.

lines.zh: 伤痕累累的异特龙垂下了头。
lines.en: The injured Allosaurus lowered its head.

lines.zh: 伤口在异特龙的皮肉间流出鲜血。
lines.en: Blood dripped from the Allosaurus's wounds.

lines.zh: 异特龙的吼叫中夹杂着痛苦的呻吟。
lines.en: The Allosaurus's roar was marred by a groan of pain.

lines.zh: 伤口处渗出异特龙的血。
lines.en: Blood oozed from its wounds.

lines.zh: 它艰难地移动，每一步都显得痛苦。
lines.en: It moved with great difficulty, each step painful.

lines.zh: 受伤的异特龙发出痛苦的咆哮。
lines.en: The injured Allosaurus let out a painful roar.

lines.zh: 它因伤痕累累而显得疲惫不堪。
lines.en: It looked exhausted from its wounds.

lines.zh: 异特龙痛苦地舔着伤口。
lines.en: The Allosaurus licked its wounds in pain.

lines.zh: 伤痛让异特龙喘不过气来。
lines.en: Pain made the Allosaurus gasp for breath.

lines.zh: 伤口处的血迹显得格外触目惊心。
lines.en: The bloodstains on its wounds were alarming.
Prey in front of you!
Enjoy this meal!

lines.zh: 你的肉对我很有吸引力。
lines.en: Your flesh is appealing.

lines.zh: 这将会是一顿丰盛的晚餐。
lines.en: A hearty dinner.
This patch of heather is my territory.

lines.zh: 我会让这成为你的最后一餐。
lines.en: This will be your last meal.
I sniff, then step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻，你很快就会被吃掉。
lines.en: Enjoy this moment, you'll be eaten soon.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，比我跑得快？
lines.en: Can that meat in your hand outrun me?
In my territory, all meat is mine.
Should you dodge me?
Let's compare!
Bump me and you'll taste territorial teeth.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫起一地碎骨。
lines.en: My tail sweeps up a scatter of bones.
Be careful of my impact.
You'll regret this.
Avoid me, or you'll get hurt.
Don't underestimate my strength.
You don't want to touch me.
My impact is deadly.
Find a mate, reproduce.

lines.zh: 这块领地够大，够养一窝。
lines.en: This territory is big enough for a brood.
Together, you'll be stronger.
Come, let's reproduce together.
Find your partner.
I'll choose the best.
Survive together, reproduce.
Let's be a family.

lines.zh: 同类的气味，就在下风处。
lines.en: A mate's scent, just downwind.
Build a family together.
Hissss, this meat is mine!
This meat will last me two days.
Come on, feel my sharp claws!
I buried this bone three days ago.
Can you smell it? Blood!
My target is that meat pile!
Invasion of my territory!
Prey is near, time to feed!
Watch out, my tail!
Decorate with my bones?!
Target in sight!
Target is that group!
Locking target, prepare to attack!
My long-awaited prey!
Target is that cabin!
Target locked, my prey!
I see my prey!
Lock, aim, prepare to attack!
Target is that tree!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的下一个猎物！
lines.en: Target locked, my next prey!
Its border has been stepped over.
It caught the smell of your sweat.
It has put you on the menu.

lines.zh: 它选定你作为今天的猎物
lines.en: It picks you as today's prey.
My claws will tear you apart!
Target is that bone pile!
Target is that grassland!
Target locked, my prey!
Target is that meat!

lines.zh: 领地的边界，你越过来了。
lines.en: You've crossed the edge of my territory.
Target is that mountain!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的下一个猎物
lines.en: Target locked, my next prey!
Target is that river!
It lowers itself, loading its hind legs.
It fixes on your ankles.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的震动越来越响
lines.en: The rumble in its throat grows louder.
It waits for you to be alone.
Its huge jaw parts slightly.
It shortens the distance one step at a time.

lines.zh: 发出一声震耳欲聋的咆哮，巨颚一张一合。
lines.en: Roar loudly, jaws opening and closing.

lines.zh: 用锋利的牙齿撕裂猎物的肉。
lines.en: Teeth rip flesh from prey.

lines.zh: 用巨大的前肢拍打猎物。
lines.en: Use massive forelimbs to strike prey.

lines.zh: 尾巴挥动，击打逼近的敌人。
lines.en: Tail swings to strike enemies.

lines.zh: 用锋利的爪子抓挠猎物。
lines.en: Claws scratch at prey.

lines.zh: 用獠牙威胁任何接近的生物。
lines.en: Canines threaten any nearby creatures.

lines.zh: 从口中喷出火焰，烧灼猎物。
lines.en: Exhale fire to burn prey.

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫过地面，发出沉重的响声。
lines.en: Tail smacks the ground with a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 用牙齿咬断猎物的脖子。
lines.en: Jaw bites through prey's neck.

lines.zh: 将猎物拖到一旁，享用美食。
lines.en: Drag prey aside to feast.
The jaws snap shut and teeth clash.
It pins you down with a forelimb.
Its tail sweeps you off your feet.
It lowers its head and slams your chest.

lines.zh: 领地边界发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: Low growl from territory boundary.

lines.zh: 在岩石缝隙中悄然现身。
lines.en: Appears silently in rock crevices.
Slowly emerges from nest.
Searches for food at dusk.
Patrols territory in the forest.
Scours desolate lands for prey.
Lurks in cave entrance.

lines.zh: 在岩壁上留下深邃的爪痕。
lines.en: Leaves deep claw marks on rock.
Active at night, seeking prey.
Scans open ground.
The shell cracks and it pokes its head out.

lines.zh: 化石里的遗传物质醒了
lines.en: The genetic material in the fossil wakes up.

lines.zh: 培养槽里，它第一次低吼
lines.en: In the culture vat it roars for the first time.
It leaves claw marks on the rock wall.
The hatchling breaks out with only ten points.
Its first day back in the wild.
It crushes the first bone underfoot.
Revival complete; the territory is its own.
It stands up beside the incubator.
On a gust of carrion stench, it arrives.

lines.zh: 火苗舔舐着异特龙的皮肤。
lines.en: The flames licked at the Allosaurus's skin.

lines.zh: 异特龙从高处跌落，摔得满身伤。
lines.en: The Allosaurus tumbled to the ground, injured from the fall.
Water suffocated the Allosaurus.

lines.zh: 异特龙被爆炸震得遍体鳞伤。
lines.en: The explosion left the Allosaurus battered.

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿了异特龙的身体。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the Allosaurus.

lines.zh: 魔法击中异特龙，它摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: Magic struck the Allosaurus, causing it to stagger.

lines.zh: 饥饿让异特龙变得虚弱。
lines.en: Starvation weakened the Allosaurus.

lines.zh: 闪电击中异特龙，它痉挛着倒下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the Allosaurus, causing it to convulse.

lines.zh: 异特龙坠入虚空，痛苦地挣扎。
lines.en: The Allosaurus fell into the void, struggling in pain.
